sources.title: Security 51 Walkthrough — Day 1 to 14 (Level 1)
sources.version_boundary: Launch-build walkthrough; visitors explicitly described as randomized

claims.statement: Official copy names incorrect answers, protocol-breaking behavior, slurred speech, suspicious documents, infection, and other oddities as inspection signals.
The observed launch route uses document, external body, photo, thermal, organ, bone, UV, blood, and elevator evidence across progression.
Observed daily instructions can assign deny, security, or stronger allow actions to different findings, so anomaly presence alone does not determine the result.
Official material says a missed threat can spread infection and some consequences surface only after several shifts.

unknowns: No authoritative exhaustive launch-build anomaly list was found.
Probability, spawn rate, and branch-specific availability for individual findings remain unknown.
Exact ending thresholds tied to anomaly decisions remain unverified.
